finalText:
All objectives verified complete.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd64-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**), shown at the top of the ticket list. Only the Title field was required; Customer was optional and left blank. Initial status: Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd64-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 + 25%).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd64-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 + 25%).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (150 + 25%). Parts total updated to $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" was initially refused with the alert *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd64-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier; Part "fwrd64-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. The sole enforced precondition was that **every part on the ticket must have a supplier recorded** (the Supplier field is otherwise optional — inline help says "Optional. Leave blank if the part has not been sourced yet."). I set Supplier to "Acme Supplies" on both parts via their Edit dialogs, then "Mark Ready" succeeded. Detail view then showed "Status: Ready" and the action buttons switched to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed". No other precondition (customer, notes, etc.) was required.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (confirm dialogs: *"Delete the part "fwrd64-n1 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."* and the same for Part B); parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." Ticket archived via the "Archive ticket" button (no confirmation dialog — it archived immediately, button flipped to "Unarchive ticket", detail view showed "Status Ready / Archived"). Verified: the default active list (13 tickets, RD-1014…RD-1001) contains no RD-1015, and no active ticket holds either of this run's parts; RD-1015 appears only when "Show archived" is ticked, as `RD-1015 | fwrd64-n1 RD Bench Ticket (Archived badge) | Not recorded | Ready | 0 parts | 2026-09-16`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
